python-bug:line-continuation.why: Python splits at a backslash-newline's newline, so `gh pr \\<newline> create` is two commands and not counted; the shell joins the lines

python-bug:quoted-pr-create.why: Python splits commands at ; & | ( even inside quotes, so quoted text that mentions gh pr create counts as running it; Go splits shell words, so only a command that runs it counts
